title: Gộp loại bàn và không gian vào modal quản lý bàn
rootCause: The modal trigger previously lived in global navigation. The mobile follow-up was caused by the portal header lacking an isolated width contract: a global modal/button cascade could expand the close control, squeeze header copy into a one-character column, and collapse the scrollable body. The local fix uses a fixed 44px close column and a single body scroll region without changing the shared Modal or CRUD flow.
